rationale: The shared ContextMenu widget gains a slider value label (the track and pointer mapping stop short of it), a reserved minimum panel width, and deferral of set_items issued from inside an item callback, which was a use-after-free for any product that rebuilds rows from a row's own on_change. Pure widget behaviour with no Pulp-only dependency, so the next re-export carries it and Vellum menus get the same fix.
